taskMs.what: main-thread TaskDuration from the create call to settle window end

layoutStyleMs.what: LayoutDuration + RecalcStyleDuration in the same window

readyMs.what: wall clock from create call to the adapter's ready signal

readyFrameMs.what: wall clock to the first animation frame after ready

rendererCpuMs.what: CPU time of the page renderer process, all threads, same window (SystemInfo.getProcessInfo)

gpuCpuMs.what: CPU time of the GPU process, same window

heapChartBytes.what: JS heap after forced GC with the chart, minus the same with only the input data

heapUsedBytes.what: JS heap after forced GC with the chart (absolute)

rendererPssBytes.what: page renderer process PSS with the chart (Linux /proc, after GC)

rendererPssChartBytes.what: page renderer PSS with the chart minus with only the input data

gpuPssBytes.what: GPU process PSS with the chart

gpuPssChartBytes.what: GPU process PSS with the chart minus with only the input data

canvasBackingBytes.what: CALCULATED: sum of canvas.width x canvas.height x 4 over the chart canvases
